items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: Cab Calloway claims that he tried to convince Nat that he had a little stutter...

ctx.x: No. At one point before he got to California, it was so hard for a black man in the deep south, as you can imagine, he had to whiten up, he thought. Oh it’s scary. There’s a documentary that shows when he was doing it. But when he went out there, and you know, Central Avenue, and all he did with those early records was just play jazz. Cab Calloway claims that he tried to convince Nat that he had a little stutter and he was embarrassed to sing because he couldn’t really. He says, “You stand in front of a mirror…
don’t know if that’s all he did, but I’ll tell you he was one of the most articulated singers in the history of American pop music.
